title: Observer Intelligence Reconciliation Record
description: Provenance-preserving synthesis. Must retain disagreement, dependence estimates, disclosure boundaries, and resolvable lineage. Field presence is not completeness; unresolved refs must be explicit.

resolvable.description: True only if the referenced Observation Record (and its critical provenance artifacts) can be retrieved at reconciliation time.

shadow_evaluation_refs.description: Shadow Evaluation IDs consulted. Empty array is allowed but must be recorded.

effective_independent_pathways.description: Estimated N_independent after accounting for correlation.

retained_disagreement.description: Disagreement that was not collapsed. Empty array means no disagreement was recorded (must be honest).

disclosure_boundaries.description: What information was withheld from reconciliation and why (minimum-necessary principle).

transformation_summary.description: How raw observations became the reconciled state.

excluded_or_downweighted.description: Observation or critic IDs that were excluded or heavily down-weighted, with reason.

all_refs_resolvable.description: False if any contributing observation or critical provenance artifact cannot be retrieved.

missing_fields.description: Critical integrity or provenance fields that were absent.

score.description: Must be derived from resolvability and required-field presence, not from mere existence of a provenance array.

global_estimate_summary.description: Optional human-readable summary of the reconciled state. Must not replace lineage.
